name: Simulation with in- and output
description: Models information content entities as the input and output of simulation processes. Because BFO roles inhere only in independent continuants, an ICE cannot bear a role directly; the pattern introduces input assignment and output assignment as dependent entities standing for the assignment of an ICE to a process. The example is a division process with numerator and denominator as ICE inputs and a quotient as output.
competency_questions: Which information content entities are the input and output of a simulation process? How is a digital datum assigned to a process when it cannot bear a role? Which assignment realizes which part of the simulation, and what numeric value does it carry?
